CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFDIRECTORY

CFDIRECTORY with ACTION="LIST" returns the contents of a directory as a query, one row per file or subdirectory. The other actions create, rename and delete directories.

Category

File, directory and system

Syntax

<CFDIRECTORY ACTION="directory_action"
    DIRECTORY="full_path_name"
    NAME="query_name"
    FILTER="list_filter"
    SORT="sort_specification"
    MODE="permission"
    NEWDIRECTORY="new_directory_name">

Attributes

ACTION
Optional, default "LIST". LIST, CREATE, DELETE or RENAME.
DIRECTORY
Required. Full path of the directory to work on.
NAME
Required for LIST. Name of the query that receives the listing.
FILTER
Optional. For LIST, a wildcard pattern such as *.cfm or report??.txt. Matching ignores case.
SORT
Optional, default "Name ASC". For LIST, comma-separated columns, each optionally followed by ASC or DESC, for example "Type, Size DESC".
MODE
Optional. For CREATE, UNIX permissions. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion creates directories with 755.
NEWDIRECTORY
Required for RENAME. The new name. A plain name renames the directory where it is; a full path moves it.

Usage

The LIST query has these columns:

Column Contents
Name File or directory name
Size Size in bytes (0 for directories)
Type File or Dir
DateLastModified Date and time of the last change
Attributes R for read-only, H for hidden (UNIX dot files), otherwise empty
Mode UNIX permissions in octal, such as 644

Without a FILTER the listing includes the . and .. entries, just as on Windows NT; skip them with <CFIF Type IS "File"> or a FILTER. DELETE only removes an empty directory. Errors throw an Application exception with the reason in the detail.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Build a little directory in the temp area, list it, and clean up --->
<CFSET Demo = GetTempDirectory() & "cfdirectory_demo">
<CFIF NOT DirectoryExists(Demo)>
  <CFDIRECTORY ACTION="CREATE" DIRECTORY="#Demo#">
</CFIF>
<CFFILE ACTION="WRITE" FILE="#Demo#/readme.txt" OUTPUT="Read me first.">
<CFFILE ACTION="WRITE" FILE="#Demo#/index.cfm" OUTPUT="<CFOUTPUT>##Now()##</CFOUTPUT>">
<CFFILE ACTION="WRITE" FILE="#Demo#/notes.txt" OUTPUT="Remember to test on Netscape 4.7 too.">

<CFDIRECTORY ACTION="LIST" DIRECTORY="#Demo#" NAME="Listing" FILTER="*.*" SORT="Size DESC">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Name</TH><TH>Size</TH><TH>Type</TH><TH>Mode</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Listing">
<TR><TD>#Name#</TD><TD>#Size#</TD><TD>#Type#</TD><TD>#Mode#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

<CFLOOP QUERY="Listing">
  <CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="#Demo#/#Listing.Name#">
</CFLOOP>
<CFDIRECTORY ACTION="DELETE" DIRECTORY="#Demo#">
<CFOUTPUT><P>Directory removed again: #YesNoFormat(NOT DirectoryExists(Demo))#</P></CFOUTPUT>
